programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Girls on Mission
programme.desc: Emma and Stephanie accidentally rent a scary movie and suddenly there are beasts everywhere... Olivia tapes a science show, with a little help from Mia's lemonade stand - and special effects! Stephanie has to face her fears when the class gets an 'Animal Kingdom & 'school assignment.'Things are getting mixed up on Andrea's first day on the job at Heartlake City Juicebar. Andrea relaxes at the beach while Emma is hard at work at her lifeguard tower. Mia and Stephanie have to use a little horse power at the Sunshine Ranch.

programme.title: The Hands Of Time
programme.desc: Master Wu mistakenly tries to single-handedly complete a battle he began decades ago against Acronix, one of the twin Hands of Time. But the arrival of the first Time Blade – a weapon with the power to speed up time – sends the Ninja to the Monastery just in time to rescue their master from certain doom.

programme.title: The Hatching
programme.desc: The Ninja learn more about the Krux and Acronix – the two fallen Elemental Masters known as the Hands of Time – and are sure that this threat has finally been eliminated. But with Wu out of action and suffering from the effects of the Time Punch, the Ninja discover a new enemy in their midst: The Vermillion Warriors. And the Ninjas have no idea who controls them...

programme.title: A Time Of Traitors
programme.desc: Kai's investigation of a Vermillion Warrior Helmet leads him to discover that Krux is alive and well in Ninjago, living under an assumed identity. Meanwhile, as the Vermillion Warriors go on a kidnapping spree, Lloyd struggles with his role as master-in-training and Nya does her best to reboot Zane, who was knocked off line in his first battle with the Vermillion.

programme.title: The Mask Of Deception
programme.desc: When an unknown criminal syndicate threatens the Royal Family, the Ninja are called back into action and must protect the royal princess and a fabled artifact that may hold supernatural powers. The ninja find themselves scattered to the four corners of the kingdom. Cole and Jay are searching in vain for some sign of Master Wu. Nya fights injustice in the north, while Kai and Zane attempt to fend off an angry lava beast in the west. This leaves Lloyd alone in Ninjago City. He rushes to the scene of a heist at Borg Tower and finds himself up against a team of highly trained operatives led by the mysterious masked MISTER-E. Lloyd fails to prevent the heist and an ancient artifact, the MASK OF DECEPTION, is stolen. Lloyd apprehends one of the criminals but the others escape. Dismayed by his failure, Lloyd calls the ninjas back to Ninjago. The friends are reunited and hope for a little rest and relaxation. These hopes are dashed with the arrival MASTER HUTCHINS, a servant of the Royal Family of Ninjago, who has been sent by the EMPEROR to request their help. A new criminal gang, SONS OF GARMADON (SOG), is attempting to acquire three ancient masks called the ONI MASKS, which are rumored to possess supernatural powers.

programme.title: The Gray Knight
programme.desc: Using his Stone to Life magic the Cloud of Monstrox turns Clay into a living, fighting, breathing stone fighting knight. But will Clay use his forces to fight for good or for evil? Does he have a choice? The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro are able to unlock the forbidden Power Shocking Scare and unleash an attack on the village of Bravington. Knights in their new vehicles rush to the rescue and are able to defeat him with a new Combo Power. In the heat of the battle, the Cloud of Monstrox sees the stone statue of Clay and zaps him to life! Clay is now turned, and is fighting against his friends. It is impossible for them to defeat him without destroying him for good. The Cloud urges Clay on. He attacks the Fortrex in order to get to Merlok. Robin in his Black Knight Mech is trying to stop him, but to no avail. Merlok 2.0 is left undefended. At the very last moment Merlok 2.0 unleashes a blasting spell that sends Clay far far away.

programme.title: The Good, The Bad And The Tightwad
programme.desc: Clay wakes up in the poor town of Nothing Hill which literally have nothing. Will Clay remember who he is and what he is fighting for. His friends try to help him, but Jorah Tightwad and his Bots get in the way. Clay as the Gray Knight wakes up far away in a place called Nothing Hill. A poor town where they literally have nothing. They harvest dust. Jorah Tightwad though has found that there is gold underneath the town. He convinces the confused Clay to help him put pressure on the poor townsfolk to give up their lots. This is an easy job for the strong Gray Knight. The NEXO KNIGHTS finally track him down and tries to convince him about who he is. But to the Gray Knight they are still his enemies, and a giant battle ensues in order to subdue the Gray Knight. At last, only Macy is left. When she begins to recite the Knights Code, some words and their meaning are able to get through the stone hard shell of the Gray Knight and the Evil that clouded him seems to disappear. Together they are able to return the ownership of the town to the villagers.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Baby Smurf Is Missing: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Memory Melon: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf For Denisa: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Peewit's Unscrupulous Adventure: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Poltersmurf: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Greedy And The Porridge Pot: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Most Unsmurfy Games: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.desc: Panda- the Bear's distant relative pays one more visit to the Bear. They start making Chinese dump-lings, but then Masha appears, with her own methods of cooking. And a simple cooking turns into a culinary master class with butterflies!

programme.desc: The Wolves that live in the forest come with a plan to kidnap Masha and demand the Bear to pay a ransom. However the Bear is pleased to find Masha gone and he does not rush the events. Meanwhile Masha turns the Wolves' lives into a hell and they end up paying the ransom to the Bear just to get rid of her once and for all.

programme.title: Around the world in one day
programme.desc: The Bear is preparing to go on a world trip, but a last minute accident makes him panic. In the meantime, Masha knows the best way to prepare for the trip and shares it with the Bear.

programme.title: Princess and the Beast
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: Tee For Three
programme.desc: How difficult it is to remain calm when two little tombs are raging in the house. Panda and Masha are fooling around for days. To cope with stress, Bear needs a good rest. Will he be able to restore internal forces or two fidgets will not give him peace?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Masha is again playing mother and daughter with Rosie. But this time an honest lot distributed the roles. Now it's Masha's turn to put on her cap and get in the stroller. Will Rosie endure mother's everyday life?

programme.desc: The Female Bear presents Masha with a glamour magazine and now the Bear shall transform his house into a beauty salon. Get ready to learn a lesson that everything should be done with a sense of proportion, especially when it comes to beauty.

programme.title: All the world's a stage
programme.desc: The best remedy for boredom is a good game. And a good play is even better. That is exactly what our friends decided. It's just not so easy to agree on what kind of play to stage..

programme.title: The Tops and the Roots
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Ali Baba
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Tom Thumb
programme.desc: This is a story about the small but brave boy. The moral of the story is that no matter how big and tall you are, you should not offend the little ones. It may happen so that you will meet some tom thumb boy, who will beat any “giant”.

programme.title: Wee Little Havroshechka
programme.desc: There lived a woman who had three daughters - two of her own and the stepdaughter called Wee Little Havroshechka. She loved her own daughters and hated the stepdaughter who was forced to work till dawn. No matter how hard she tried to please the stepmother, she was unapproachable. Once upon a time the stepmother kicked her out of the house, but every medal has its flipside – Wee Little Havroshechka met her Prince and they lived happily ever after, and it's all because she was hard-working and clean.

programme.title: Quartet Plus
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Tour de Forest
programme.desc: Himalayan Bear is once again competing with Bear! This time they have arranged a bike race, but something doesn't smell right: Himalayan Bear intends on cheating to win! Good thing Masha stands as a guardian of justice and always comes to a friend's aid!

programme.title: What's Inside?
programme.desc: "What is inside such seemingly simple objects surrounding us? How are the mechanisms that we use every day arranged? Maybe they work with the help of magic? Or maybe each system has a certain order?In this episode, Masha decides to figure out how the objects surrounding her are arranged. And in the company of an old friend, this research becomes an adventure. "

programme.title: Try, Try Again
programme.desc: A van with Monkeys arrived at the Bear's house. They invite everyone to test themselves with the help of an attraction - a power meter. The Bear is confident that he will easily win the main prize. But things didn't go according to plan. And now the main strongman of the forest cannot do without the help of his friends.

programme.title: Princess and the Beast
programme.desc: Shocking and sensation! For the first time in our forest! A couple of tourists broke into the Bear's house without an invitation in search of impressions and cool photos. And there they are - just a sleepy Bear and Masha, who really wants to play. Rejoice tourists! You will have impressions, photos, and obstacle course from here and to the city itself!

programme.title: First Day Of School
programme.desc: With the beginning of September, Masha, like all the children wants to go to school and asks the Bear to make her one. Overwhelmed with enthu-siasm, the Bear completes the task and the next day Masha sits at a brand new desk and tries to act as an attentive student but ends up bringing the Bear to absolute madness.

programme.title: Fishy story
programme.desc: Summer is a time of rest and miracles. How nice is just to sit on the river bank with your best friends! However, everything is not so simple in our story. The Bear didn't even suspect what kind of adventure he was going to find on his fishing trip. While Masha and She-Bear frightened by his sudden disappearance, explore the neighborhood, he ... however, you will find out everything yourself in our new episode.

programme.title: Don't Wake Till Spring!
programme.desc: The autumn has arrived. The Bear prepares for his winter bedtime by barricading himself from Masha inside the house. But the little girl manages to find her way indoors and causes yet another mess by awakening a whole swarm of bees. But all her games eventually stop and when the Bear cooks some porridge to feed the child, he discovers her fallen asleep.

programme.title: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: At first time in her life Masha is frightened in earnest, however this creepy story shook up the whole forest and now hardly anyone can stay away from these strange scenes! And what would you do if your own pillow and blanket turn into real ghosts?! A real ghost story, oh yeah!

programme.title: The Very Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Masha loves fairy tales and of course she believes that each fairy tale should lead to happy end, even if nothing contributes to it! That's how the story goes… The Bear still hopes to win the heart of the female Bear. He finds an ancient gondola at the bottom of the forest lake. The Bear decides to restore it and invites the female Bear for a romantic ride! No one would have expected that this story would perfectly match Masha's new hobby - puppet theatre.

programme.title: Time To Ride My Pony
programme.desc: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way – playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game and to everyone's surprise, she outsmarts and outplays both the Bear and his friend with just one chess figure.

programme.title: The Grand Piano Lesson
programme.desc: The bear finds a beautiful black piano in the forest. He happily takes it home, fixes and tunes it and begins to play some music. Masha couldn't help staying away from this lovely instrument. She decides to become a world famous pianist, she asks the Bear to teach her how to play the piano.

programme.title: Arts and Crafts Day
programme.desc: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

programme.title: The Foundling
programme.desc: Occasionally Masha finds an egg, from which a penguin hatches. The Bear has to take double care now. He cooks special dishes and builds mini aqua park for little penguin and Masha. Finally the Bear figures out that the penguin will be happy only in suitable weather conditions and send the penguin Antarctica on a little plane.

programme.title: See You Later
programme.desc: This day will change Bear's life forever. To everyone's surprise, Masha has suddenly grown up, getting all the forest dwellers shocked by her exceptionally good behavior. Her sister Dasha is going to take her back to the big city, which really upsets the Bear and others.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauties
programme.desc: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

programme.title: We Come In Peace!
programme.desc: In the courtyard of the Bear's house a spaceship makes an emergency landing. The aliens need to urgently replenish their supplies and return home. Only on the ground everything is arranged differently than at home. Masha and Mishka will help them to understand what's what, fix the ship and go back to home.

programme.title: Scary Story About Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Are you sure that you really like spooky stories? What if this kind of story will get you really thrilled? Listen to one classic story and don't say that you are not shocked after all!

programme.title: Soul Freezing Tale Of Grim Forest And Tiny Timid Bug
programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Terrible Truth About Those Who Are Afraid To Be Little
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Gloomy Story About The Darkest Dreams
programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Bloodcurdling Saga About Joyful Event
programme.desc: Everyone think that it's so scary to be little as there are so many things are not accessible for you! But in reality there is no difference how little you are if there is someone who cares for you and someone you care about…

programme.title: Grim Parable About Superstitious Girl
programme.desc: Some people happen to believe in all sorts of omens like black cats, wearing clothes inside out, prophetic dreams… Poor girl Lucy believed in that kind of stuff so much that was even afraid to go outside to play with her friends. And how could you go out if you were born in the year of Purple rabbit that promises…no matter what… You'll see…

programme.title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

One becomes a priest, the other is an activist who becomes a spy for the fascist movement. As the battles are waged, the characters' lives collide...

programme.title: Shattered Earth. Cloudy Mountain
programme.desc: A peaceful town turns into a living hell when a devastating earthquake is triggered, causing buildings to tumble and sinkholes to open. A retired railway soldier and his son, an explosives engineer, travel deep into a cave to rescue trapped survivors.

programme.title: She's Missing
programme.desc: Heidi and Jane are best friends living in a desert small town. When Jane, a Rodeo Queen contestant and military wife goes missing Heidi, now alone in the world must begin a search across the desert for her friend. She digs up secrets and encounters the violence of life on the road, crossing paths with a series of unusual men and women in her search for an honest connection in a dishonest world.

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: Dad Longworth and Rio hit up a bank in Mexico, but Dad bails with the cash, leaving Rio to get caught by the Rurales. After five years, Rio breaks out and is set on getting back at Dad. But then, things get complicated when he falls for Dad's step-daughter.

programme.title: Starting Up Love
programme.desc: When workaholic Jillian gets a note that her long-lost, wealthy uncle has passed away, she finds he's left her his beautiful mountainside cabin – and a family she never knew existed. Jillian's plan is to sell the cabin as soon as possible and move on, but when she meets handsome caretaker Liam, he makes her an offer she can't refuse. Sparks fly as they work together to transform the cabin into a holiday resort. When business doesn't go as planned and she almost loses her newfound family, Jillian needs to make a decision. Will she give up everything for the love she never saw coming?

programme.title: Knowing
programme.desc: A professor (Nicolas Cage) deciphers a mysterious code foretelling future calamities. Can he somehow avert them?

programme.title: Black Dynamite

programme.title: Uptown Girls: Uptown Girls (2003)
programme.desc: Molly Gunn is the daughter of a late rock legend, and the toast of New York City. But when her inheritance is stolen, Molly is forced to do something she's never done before - get a job. Molly becomes a nanny to a girl, who is "eight going on forty."

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Compromised by his affair with the first lady, a veteran secret service agent is framed as a potential presidential assassin and must rely on a hostile former prot‚g‚ to flush out the real culprit.

programme.title: Limitless

programme.title: Good Night, and Good Luck.

Three American tourists are backpacking through the remote countryside of European Georgia when one of them gets trapped on an armed landmine. That seems to be a minor threat compared to the nightmarish happenings the rest of the afternoon will bring on however. A psychopath takes advantage of the tourist's immobility and brutally assaults the woman he loves.

programme.title: Ghost World
programme.desc: Deliciously dry and quirky, Ghost World, based on the cult comic book, is like no other teen comedy you've seen before! Original and terrifically funny, Ghost World is a raw-edged comedy that follows Enid (Thora Birch - American Beauty) and Rebecca (Scarlett Johansson - The Horse Whisperer), two teenage girls who have always been too cool to bother with the losers in their high school. Embarrassing the local 'freaks' and laughing at all around, their friendship is founded on the mutual conviction that pretty much everything sucks!

programme.title: Kill Your Darlings (2013)

programme.title: The World's Fastest Indian
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins stars as Burt Munro, a man who never let the dreams of youth fade. After a lifetime of perfecting his classic Indian motorcycle, Burt set off from the bottom of the world to test his bike at the Bonneville Salt Flats in Utah. With all the odds against him, he set a new speed record and captured the spirit of his times. Burt Munro's 1967 world record remains unbroken and his legend lives on today.

programme.title: Hell Is Where The Home Is

programme.title: The Owners
programme.desc: One night in 1990s rural England, a retired couple finds their isolated house besieged by a gang of young criminals. The thieves think it will be easy to make them give up the secret of their safe. But they have no idea what nightmare they've gotten themselves into as they fight to escape the house alive.

A gun-slinging western starring Chad Michael Murray (One Tree Hill), Luke Wilson (The Ridiculous 6) and Francesca Eastwood (True Crime).

programme.title: The Bike Thief

The Rider is an ordinary, hard-working man who is a delivery driver for a local restaurant, which is owned and run by his landlord. When the Riders moped is stolen, his world turns upside down and a race against time starts to recover the source of his livelihood.

programme.desc: Home appliance developer Seo Jisung dreams of an easy life like a welldesigned algorithm. The “smart voice recognition AI refrigerator” she is in the process of developing accidentally gets combined with an antiterrorism super sensor chip that went missing from the National Intelligence Service Korea. Her refrigerator that couldn't even determine whether an ingredient was rotten suddenly identifies human lowlifes without even needing her to tell it to. This leads to revealing the truth about Jisung's fiancé. The man she thought of as an elite was actually a criminal. At the perfect timing, Jung Gukhee, a firefighter that seems too good to be true shows up in her life.

programme.title: Paapnaashini Ganga
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Humkadam
programme.desc: Humkadam is a first of its kind show on Indian television that presents the complicated dynamics of ‘Saas' and ‘Bahu' in a clutter breaking manner. It tells the story of Tara and Shanti who are two diametrically opposite personalities, stuck in unprecedented situations. Just when they thought life had come to a full stop, is where they had to put their differences aside and start a new journey. Will they become each other's Humkadam to face all the adversities together?

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. programme.title: Armor Monster
programme.desc: One day, 12-year-old Zachary once again met the subway "0" which her mother took nine years ago, and the appearance of the subway seems to have some connection with the necklace left by her mother. In order to find her mother, Zachary stepped on the magic subway without hesitation! When the train arrived at the station, Zachary found that he had come to a magical world of elves. He also met the elf Rooney chased by hunters. In order to protect the Rooney, they fled to the underground city. Here, Zachary meets Scarlett, a red haired girl, and Zachary accidently becomes the Rooney and is regarded as a half-face hunter who is under searched with big bonus in the underground city. In order to leave the underground city to find his mother, Zachary has to agree to fight with the old wizard, the King of the underground city. Under Scarlett's training, Zachary grew up fast. In the battle, his determination to protect the Rooney inspired the strength in the necklace and defeated the old wizard. And just when the angry wizard decided to show his real strength, the real half hunter came to the rescue. The real half hunter even had the same necklace. The unexpected encounter of the two necklaces triggered the emergence of spirits and demons which are eager for energy. In order to protect the underground city from being ravage, the half-face hunter left the underground city with Zachary and his friends. They used their tactics to temporarily eliminate the demons in the stone forest near the beast forest, and they entered the beast forest to avoid refuge.

programme.title: Bablu Dablu Monster Paln
programme.desc: The crazy scientist, Doctor Rex Vector, and his hamster assistant, Mister Pete, return to Pine Tree Mountain with Vector's new, evil invention: a robo-monster complete with animal abilities. But first, Vector needs to collect these skills. He comes up with a power absorbing gadget, which he often disguises, in order to trap and steal abilities from the innocent animals. Vick, Briar and Bramble, along with other animal friends, must stand up against this “monster plan” of Vector's. It's going to be a fierce fight between wild animals and poaching villains.

programme.title: Ekaant
programme.desc: India is known for its remarkable architecture and serene landscapes. Its rich history is steeped in mystery its vastness - lends itself to several stories and urban legends. Ekaant takes you through the abandoned roads and alleys of some of India's historic locations. Travelling through the spread out palaces and deserted forts, the show documents and investigates the eerie processes of abandonment of each site. How flourishing towns and cities came to be in ruins, is the question each episode seeks to answer. Ekaant explores the ceasing of life and the triumph of nature even in the most populated of places and takes you on the road no longer travelled.

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Kahi Suni
programme.desc: In a land steeped in mysticism, spirituality, and religion, the imagination of the followers has much room to flourish. Stories abound – some based on truth and some only on fractions of the truth. Nevertheless, these stories have enchanted their listeners for eons. Kahi Suni packs away our skepticism and takes us on a ride through the legendary tales of India. Each destination covered in the episodes has been the birthplace of a legend and each legend has given rise to the recognition of that location. Following our host from north to south and east to west, we journey through the land of myths of legends uncovering the origins of evIery story.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Full of luxurious treats, the northern Italian region of Lombardy offers rich and delicious cuisine. For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. Michael's dolce looks solely at chocolate, creating a creamy and crunchy Chocolate Salami. Full of nuts, cookies, and creamy chocolate, this rich dessert is a wonderful way to finish off any meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF's Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly's ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky's own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly's horse wins the race. At Louisville's Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: La Rosa Velenosa
programme.desc: Carson Phillips, investigatore privato, viene coinvolto dalla sua ex-moglie in una indagine relativa all'uccisione del fidanzato della figlia. L'indagine prenderà una piega inaspettata.

programme.title: Moschettieri a 4 zampe
programme.desc: Barkos, Wagos e Dogtanion sono tre cani che intraprendono un mirabolante viaggio per salvare il Natale, rubato da un gruppo di ladri inquietanti.

programme.title: Spirito selvaggio
programme.desc: Kacie, una ragazza dallo spirito ribelle, trova uno spirito affine in Blaze, un cavallo da corsa che si rifiuta di essere addomesticato.

programme.title: Alpha & Omega
programme.desc: Due giovani lupi in contrasto l'uno con l'altro si trovano a doversi alleare per far fronte alla situazione sfavorevole nella quale sono finiti

programme.title: Gli acchiappamostri
programme.desc: Un'avventura soprannaturale per tutta la famiglia. Alex vuole aiutare il suo fratellino a smettere di avere incubi, quindi decide di formare una squadra per prendersi cura dei suoi mostri immaginari.

programme.title: I Puffi
programme.desc: S1:E31 La Capsula Del Tempo - Mentre i Puffi costruiscono una capsula del tempo per tutti i loro talenti, Grande Puffo cerca freneticamente di svelare un antico enigma druidico prima che un disastro colpisca la foresta.

programme.title: I Puffi
programme.sub-title: S1:E32 Golosone E La Pentola Magica | Il Puffo Senza Voce
programme.desc: S1:E32 Golosone E La Pentola Magica | Il Puffo Senza Voce - Une fatina buona regala a Golosone una pentola magica... | I Puffi hanno perso la parola per un incantesimo di Gargamella...

programme.title: I Puffi
programme.sub-title: S1:E33 Il Gigante Di Gargamella | Il Castello Della Discordia
programme.desc: S1:E33 Il Gigante Di Gargamella | Il Castello Della Discordia - Il malvagio mago Gargamella vuole creare un mostro. Un'orribile e gigantesca creatura, un essere impressionante che distruggerà tutti i Puffi!| Nel Castello di Quarrel non si sente quasi mai una parola gentile. Sia Selwyn lo Stregone che Tallulah, la sua compagna strega, passano il tempo a litigare.

programme.title: Action
programme.desc: Bruno Martel è un attore fallito, ridottosi a girare piccoli ruoli in film di serie b, che viene ripetutamente tradito dalla moglie Ann, una fotomodella. L'uomo decide allora di buttarsi nel cinema porno, ma l'ambiente lo disgusta a tal punto da farlo fuggire insieme ad Ofelia, una sua giovane collega di set.

programme.title: Un'età da sballo
programme.desc: La sedicenne Giulia, figlia di uno scrittore e pittore di successo, lascia il collegio e trascorre le vacanze nella villa di famiglia, al mare, con un gruppo di amici della sua età.

programme.title: Il solco di pesca
programme.desc: Un ex seminarista abbandona gli abiti talari per dedicarsi alla fotografia e alla bellezza femminile.

programme.title: Quella peste di Pierina
programme.desc: Pierina ha soltanto tredici anni ed adora fare brutti scherzi a chiunque, soprattutto a scuola e a casa. Gianmaria è un ragazzino innamorato di lei, ma la giovane non ha intenzione di ricambiarlo.

programme.title: Totò, Fabrizi e i giovani d'oggi
programme.desc: Il mitico Totò e il grande Aldo Fabrizi in una delle commedie più divertenti di sempre. Il cavalier Cocozza e il ragionier D'Amore hanno in comune solo una parlantina inarrestabile e una potente vocazione polemica. I due, acerrimi nemici, negano il consenso alle nozze dei loro figli che le proveranno tutte per riuscire a sposarsi. Ci riusciranno?

programme.title: Peccato che sia una canaglia
programme.desc: La vita di Paolo (Marcello Mastroianni), un tranquillo e indolente autista di taxi, viene sconvolta dall'incontro con Lina (Sophia Loren), una bella ragazza, abile in borseggi e piccole truffe. Lina e la sua famiglia, sconclusionata come lei, affascinano Paolo che ce la mette tutta per redimere la ragazza. Con Vittorio De Sica nei panni del Prof. Stroppiani, padre di Lina.

programme.title: Il Mantenuto
programme.desc: Stefano Garbelli, impiegato romano, viene coinvolto dalla prostituta Daniela, che lo indica come suo protettore per difendersi dai magnaccia. Daniela si finge infermiera, suscitando l'interesse di Stefano. Inconsapevolmente, Stefano diventa il suo protettore agli occhi dei rivali e della polizia, che lo convoca al commissariato insieme agli aggressori.

programme.title: L'impiegato
programme.desc: Splendida commedia con Nino Manfredi. Estremamente ligio al lavoro, un giovane impiegato non si concede mai distrazioni di alcun genere, sfogando tutte le sue pulsioni più intime ed i suoi desideri di realizzazione con intensi sogni. Il suo mondo sembra sgretolarsi con l'arrivo di una donna a capo dell'azienda che metterà a soqquadro le sue abitudini. Diretta da Gianni Puccini.

programme.title: Ciao maschio
programme.desc: Il rifiuto della paternità e la scelta di adottare come figlio una scimmietta saranno per il protagonista, Lafayette , l'ultima e delirante affermazione di individualità.

programme.title: L'ingorgo
programme.desc: Un corteo di macchine procede sempre più lentamente lungo la tangenziale di Roma, sino a che ogni possibilità di movimento si blocca. L`ingorgo durerà 36 ore. Sin dai primi momenti il nervosismo dei viaggiatori è evidente. Quando sfumano le speranze di una veloce soluzione, mancano notizie, si palesano le prime necessità, la tensione sale al massimo e non pochi trascendono. La circostanza permette di scoprire i lati peggiori dell`umanità presente...

programme.title: La grande abbuffata
programme.desc: In una villa fuori Parigi quattro vecchi amici si riuniscono per un week-end abbandonandosi ad un`orgia di cibo e sesso. Uno di loro, Marcello, porta con sé alcune prostitute che disgustate dall`ambiente se ne andranno. Ad un certo punto una maestra va lì per caso con in suoi alunni in visita al giardino della villa, rimane affascinata dai quattro e decide di fare ritorno unendosi a loro nel folle e autodistruttivo fine settimana...

programme.title: Una giornata particolare
programme.desc: 6 maggio 1938. La Roma fascista è in festa per l`arrivo del Fuhrer in visita dal Duce. In un angolo di Roma più lontano dai fasti, in un edificio popolare, Antonietta, casalinga madre di sei figli, cresciuta nel culto del Duce, incontra casualmente per la prima volta il suo vicino di casa, Gabriele, ex annunciatore radiofonico omosessuale e prossimo al confino. Dopo la diffidenza iniziale, il loro rapporto si trasforma in affetto e comprensione...

programme.title: Il mondo di Apu
programme.desc: Apu vive a Calcutta, ha dovuto smettere di studiare per difficoltà economiche e non riesce a trovare lavoro. Si sposa con Apurna che morirà nel dare alla luce un bambino mentre lui è altrove. Apu, disperato, cercherà di ritrovare il figlio. Nel frattempo è stato assunto come operaio in una fabbrica.

programme.title: La Gatta
programme.desc: Cora, detta "La Gatta", fa parte di un gruppo partigiano. Il suo amante si spaccia per un giornalista svizzero, ma in realtà è un ufficiale tedesco, il cui compito è quello di smantellare la resistenza in quella regione. Quando Cora si accorge di come stanno le cose è troppo tardi: i suoi compagni vengono tutti arrestati e lei viene uccisa per aver tradito.

programme.title: Lei
programme.desc: Los Angeles, in un futuro non troppo lontano. Theodore, un uomo solitario dal cuore spezzato che si guadagna da vivere scrivendo lettere “personali” per gli altri, acquista un sistema informatico di nuova generazione progettato per soddisfare tutte le esigenze dell'utente. Il nome della voce del sistema operativo è Samantha, che si dimostra sensibile, profonda e divertente. Il rapporto di Theodore e Samantha crescerà e l'amicizia si trasformerà in amore ma…

programme.title: The Artist
programme.desc: Un divo del muto cade in disgrazia con l'invenzione del sonoro. Verrà salvato dall'amore di una sua fan.L'evento in bianco e nero che ha conquistato Cannes.

programme.title: TUTTA COLPA DEL CIOCCOLATO
programme.desc: Pochi giorni prima di una gara tra cioccolatieri, Aria si trova senza compagno di squadra. Dopo aver pubblicato un annuncio online, Ryan si offre come sostituo. Ma il loro andare d'accordo sarà legato solo al cioccolato?

programme.title: LA MAPPA DELL'AMORE
programme.desc: Avery va in Florida alla ricerca dei posti più romantici da inserire nel suo articolo. Sarà aiutata da Ian, guida turistica, che però ha un'idea diversa di romanticismo…

programme.title: DALL'ITALIA CON AMORE
programme.desc: Il giorno del suo compleanno, Ariel descrive l'uomo ideale e lui appare come per magia. Tra sogni e realtà, dovrà scegliere tra l'amore perfetto e quello vero trovato nel ristorante di Daniel.

programme.title: IL KIT DELL'AMORE
programme.desc: Quando il padre di Olivia, modellista, decide di andare in pensione, lei è convinta di essere la candidata ideale per succedergli. Ma poi arriva Simon, il cui modo di pensare fuori dagli schemi minaccia di sconvolgere la tranquilla vita di Olivia e il suo ruolo di erede.

programme.title: Se mi amate
programme.desc: Un medico si innamora della figlia di un paziente milionario in coma. Nonostante sia arrivato il momento di staccare la spina, il dottore deve combattere contro avvocati senza scrupoli che vogliono tenere l'uomo in vita, nell'interesse dell'ospedale.

programme.title: Napoli Serenata Calibro 9
programme.desc: Durante una rapina, quattro balordi uccidono una donna ed un bambino: sono la moglie e il figlio di Don Salvatore Savastano, temuto contrabbandiere che da quel momento si trasforma in un giustiziere solitario senza altro altro scopo che la vendetta.

programme.title: Istruzioni non incluse
programme.desc: Valentin è un playboy di Acapulco. Un giorno sulla sua porta viene lasciata una bambina e l'uomo decide di crescerla come fosse sua, cambiando così stile di vita ed arrivando a conquistare Hollywood come stuntman.

programme.title: Half Nelson
programme.desc: Candidatura agli Oscar per Ryan Gosling. Dan è un insegnante di scuola pubblica, brillante e capace di motivare i suoi allievi nonostante le difficoltà della vita di periferia. Nel privato però affoga i suoi tormenti nell'abuso di alcool e droghe.

programme.title: La baia di Eva
programme.desc: Nel caldo sud della Louisiana degli anni ‘60, la giovane Eve Batiste scopre gli oscuri segreti della sua famiglia benestante. Dopo aver assistito a un tradimento del padre, il carismatico dottor Louis Batiste, la sua innocenza si sgretola tra verità scomode e superstizioni. Un dramma avvolto da mistero e magia, dove il confine tra ricordi e realtà si fa sempre più labile.

programme.title: The Dark
programme.desc: Un mattatoio di Welch è lo scenario di una serie di eventi misteriosi che colpiscono una giovane famiglia perseguitata dal fantasma arrabbiato di un bambino morto proprio lì anni prima.

Janet si trasferisce da sola in un nuovo appartamento. La ragazza comincia ad essere vittima di allucinazioni e scopre che tra quelle quattro mura aleggia un'inquietante presenza, che la condurrà al suicidio. Lara, la sorella, decide allora di indagare sulla scomparsa della sorella...

programme.title: Beastly
programme.desc: Bello e arrogante, Kyle viene trasformato in un “mostro”. Solo l'amore vero potrà salvarlo. Una favola dark dove l'apparenza non conta più.

programme.title: Crucifixion
programme.desc: Padre Dumitru e alcune suore compiono un violento esorcismo su suor Adelina, che si crede posseduta da un demone. A seguito della morte di quest'ultima, i suoi aguzzini vengono arrestati con l'accusa di omicidio. Nella capitale giunge Nicole, giornalista newyorchese, che vuole indagare sul caso.

programme.title: Principessa cercasi
programme.desc: A medieval romance novelist is hired to be a matchmaker for a real-life prince in a desperate attempt to find true love before the fixed royal wedding date.

programme.title: Una Principessa a Manhattan
programme.desc: Lexi è devastata quando le viene chiesto di rinunciare alla sua vita a New York per riprendere la sua identità segreta di Principessa Reale. Sotto lo sguardo attento di un affascinante ma irritante guardia del corpo, riuscirà a compiere il suo destino e a trovare l'amore allo stesso tempo?

programme.title: L'amore non ha prezzo
programme.desc: Dopo aver scoperto che uno degli oggetti nel suo negozio di seconda mano è una teiera antica del valore di $80K, Rose si ritrova nel mirino di un ambizioso broker di antiquariato. Lui è determinato, ma lei si rifiuta di vendere finché non riesce a trovare il proprietario originale.

programme.title: La lingua dell'amore
programme.desc: Linguistics Ph.D. student Julie, can speak almost every language you can imagine. Things turn upside down for Julie when handsome Dan, contacts her to get some French classes. Sparks soon fly - could this be their perfect match?

programme.title: Un amore per sempre
programme.desc: Emma è un'organizzatrice di eventi che non ha tempo per l'amore, finché sua sorella non rivela che il suo matrimonio è tra sei settimane. Emma accetta di intervenire e pianificarlo da sola con l'aiuto di Liam, con cui Emma ha avuto un disastroso appuntamento al buio anni fa.

programme.title: Bouquet d'amore
programme.desc: Quando la talentuosa botanica Violet ha bisogno di aiuto per preparare le composizioni floreali per un matrimonio di alto profilo, si rivolge a Jack, un affascinante fotografo naturalista che si è assunto la responsabilità di gestire il vivaio di fiori del nonno.

programme.title: La favola di Emma
programme.desc: Emma ha creato un sito web di lifestyle di successo chiamato "Classically Emma". Quando i suoi numeri iniziano a diminuire, si allea con la giovane Jill che ha i suoi stessi sogni. Jesse, il protettivo fratello di Jill, diventerà un ostacolo sulla strada verso il successo di Emma?

programme.title: Dopo l'uragano
programme.desc: La vita di un giovanissimo cuoco viene travolta dall'arrivo dell'uragano Sandy nel 2012.

programme.title: Istantanea d'amore
programme.desc: Dopo essersi lasciata alle spalle la vita della grande città, la fotografa di matrimoni Jessie Brookes è più felice che mai. Quando il famoso attore Nate Brown si presenta nel vigneto dei suoi genitori per il matrimonio della sorella, lei capisce subito che in lui c'è molto di più di quanto sembri.

programme.title: Un fidanzato in regalo
programme.desc: Callie Fitzgerald è stanca che la sua famiglia cerchi di sistemarla mettendo in discussione la sua condizione di single. È decisa a trovare un finto fidanzato per la festa del suo 35° compleanno, in modo che la sua famiglia la lasci in pace.

programme.title: The Bread, My Sweet
programme.desc: Quando Dominic progetta di sposare la figlia di Bella, due mondi si scontrano in questa toccante e romantica storia d'amore, sogni e biscotti.

programme.title: Un tavolo per due
programme.desc: Leigh gestisce il sito web "Bad Date Chronicles". Quando il blogger rivale Conner diventa il soggetto di uno dei suoi post, i due decidono di uscire insieme per vedere chi dei due è il "cattivo frequentatore".

programme.title: Un Natale di ricordi
programme.desc: Darcy e Aiden sono rattristati dall'imminente chiusura del centro ricreativo della loro comunità. Per salvarlo, e con esso lo spirito natalizio, Darcy e Aiden intraprendono un viaggio dove un ospite inaspettato unisce tutti per una vacanza magica.

programme.title: Mozart and the whale
programme.desc: Donald e Isabel sono affetti dalla sindrome di Asperger. Gli stravolgerà la vita e lui non potrà che innamorarsene perdutamente.

programme.title: Amore in azione
programme.desc: Un esperto di fitness deve mettere in forma una star del cinema per il suo prossimo film d'azione.

programme.title: Il fiume della vita
programme.desc: Un viaggio sul Danubio riapre ferite familiari e offre a Daniela la possibilità di riconciliarsi col passato.

programme.title: La signora di Purity Falls
programme.desc: Una vedova si trasferisce a Purity Falls ma il rapporto con suo figlio si deteriora presto.

programme.title: Kung fu Mamma
programme.desc: Un agente segreto in pensione torna in servizio per fermare un trafficante d'armi.

programme.title: Tutto Ciò che Voglio
programme.desc: Wendy è Autistica, viene aiutata dalla terapia della struttura specializzata di Scottie, proteggendo la sua rigida routine quotidiana e permettendo che la ragazza coltivi la sua passione, ovvero la visione della saga televisiva Star Trek.

programme.title: In Fabric
programme.desc: Periodo di vendite invernali in un grande magazzino, dove un abito maledetto fa il passaggio da persona a persona, con conseguenze devastanti...

programme.title: Il gabbiano
programme.desc: Nella casa di campagna dell'anziano Sorin giungono sua sorella Irina, un'attrice famosa, accompagnata dall'amante Boris, uno scrittore di successo. Il figlio di Irina, Konstantin, aspira a diventare un drammaturgo.

programme.title: A Kid Like Jake
programme.desc: Alex Wheeler e suo marito Greg stanno cercando di trovare la scuola elementare giusta per il loro figlio di 4 anni, Jake. Descritto come gender-expansive dal suo consulente, il comportamento sempre più irregolare di Jake inizia a causare una spaccatura tra la coppia. Alex teme che gli adulti della sua vita lo stiano etichettando prematuramente, mentre Greg si chiede se la passione di Jake per i travestimenti non sia solo una fase.

programme.title: Giorno 122
programme.desc: Il film narra le vicende di un gruppo di sopravvissuti ad una catastrofe planetaria. Sono tutti passeggeri di un treno che al momento del disastro si trovavano in viaggio da Roma a Milano. Isolati sull'Appennino, dopo avere atteso invano i soccorsi, i nostri si mettono in cammino alla ricerca di viveri e di un riparo.

programme.title: Le mirabolanti avventure di Faga
programme.desc: Ignazio Virgilio Fagaroni, per gli amici ""Faga"" (anche se di amici, a suo dire, non ne ha), è un ragazzo problematico destinato ad una vita banale e monotona. Questo fino a quando troverà una valigetta super misteriosa che lo catapulterà in diverse mirabolanti avventure.

programme.title: Be Kind Rewind
programme.desc: Un negozio di vhs rischia di chiudere, per via dello strapotere dei dvd. Per risolvere alcuni problemi, il proprietario della videoteca ne affida temporaneamente la gestione ad un commesso. Durante l'assenza del proprietario, tutte le videocassette si smagnetizzano. Il commesso ed un suo amico decidono quindi di realizzare una versione amatoriale di alcuni dei film presenti nel negozio, per evitarne il fallimento.

programme.title: La nostra vacanza in Scozia
programme.desc: Doug, Abi e i loro tre ragazzi, viaggiano verso le highlands scozzesi per la festa di compleanno di Gordie, il padre dell'uomo. Sin da subito appare chiaro che, per mantenere al sicuro un segreto dal resto dei parenti, Doug ed Abi devono stare attenti a cosa dicono i loro figli…

programme.title: Motel Woodstock
programme.desc: Il film racconta la storia di Tiber, un uomo comune che gestiva assieme ai genitori un motel, tenendo nascosta la propria omosessualità. Tiber fu l'uomo che riuscì a trovare il luogo adatto e le licenze necessarie per dar vita ad uno degli eventi che hanno segnato la storia della musica, del costume e non solo, il Festival di Woodstock.

programme.title: About Last Night
programme.desc: Kevin Hart, Michael Ealy, Regina Hall e Joy Bryant sono i protagonisti di questa divertentissima commedia romantica su ciò che gli uomini e le donne cercano in un rapporto a due. Bernie (Kevin Hart) e Joan (Regina Hall) sono una coppia a cui piace molto flirtare, passionali in tutto dalle conquiste alle rotture. Quando lui combina un incontro tra il suo migliore amico Danny (Michael Ealy), e la coinquilina di Joan, Debbie (Joy Bryant), tra i due scatta subito una forte attrazione e iniziano a frequentarsi, ma il rapporto non è semplice e Danny e Debbie cercano di sopravvivere barcamenandosi tra i problemi della vita reale e la camera da letto.

programme.title: La cosa più dolce
programme.desc: Quando si tratta di uscire con un uomo, Christina Walters (Cameron Diaz) ha una regola d'oro: evitare l'uomo giusto e concentrarsi su quello del momento. Questo, fino a quando non conosce inaspettatamente Peter (Thomas Jane), che il giorno dopo scompare. Lei sa solo che deve presenziare a un matrimonio, ma non sa che è il suo. Insieme alla migliore amica Courtney (Christina Applegate), Christina decide di infrangere le regole e andarlo a cercare, imbattendosi in varie e divertenti disavventure durante il viaggio. Connubio di un film on the road, umorismo e ricerca dell'uomo perfetto, The Sweetest Thing è una commedia romantica piuttosto amara, una svolta nuova sulla ricerca dell'amore.

programme.title: Selvaggi in fuga
programme.desc: Ricky, un ragazzino di città, viene dato in affido a una famiglia di campagna della Nuova Zelanda. Si sente subito a casa con la nuova famiglia affidataria: la zia Bella, l'irascibile zio Hec e il cane Tupac. A seguito di un drammatico avvenimento, Ricky rischia di essere spedito in un'altra casa. Ciò spingerà il ragazzino ed Hec a fuggire nei boschi. Con la caccia all'uomo che ne consegue, i due sono costretti a mettere da parte le loro divergenze e a collaborare per sopravvivere.

programme.title: Quel Nano Infame
programme.desc: Un boss malavitoso offre al ladro di gioielli (alto circa 90 cm e rilasciato di recente con la condizionale) Calvin Sims e al suo partner Percy 100.000 dollari per rubare un famoso diamante. Ma la rapina fallisce e Calvin fa cadere il gioiello nella borsetta di Vanessa Edwards.

programme.title: Le spie vengono dal semifreddo
programme.desc: Due portieri siciliani fermano il piano di Goldfoot per scatenare una guerra, ma finiscono prigionieri in Siberia

programme.title: Arrivano i bersaglieri
programme.desc: 20 settembre 1870: i bersaglieri entrano a Roma tra uccisioni, amori e vendette sullo sfondo papale

programme.title: La gatta da pelare
programme.desc: Mara e Stefano hanno alcuni problemi: lei va dallo psicoanalista Maraldi, lui lo minaccia e lo "uccide" nei fumetti

programme.title: Le favolose notti d'Oriente
programme.desc: Due lestofanti raccontano Le Mille e una notte erotiche per soddisfare lo sceicco e salvarsi la vita.

programme.title: Il marito
programme.desc: Alberto Sordi interpreta un uomo che, coinvolto in una serie di equivoci e malintesi, si trova a dover affrontare le difficoltà della sua vita matrimoniale. Una commedia che esplora con ironia le dinamiche delle relazioni e del matrimonio.

programme.title: Totò Sexy
programme.desc: Due suonatori ambulanti finiscono in carcere per contrabbando e si rifugiano in sogni popolati da donne seducenti e atmosfere esotiche. Una commedia musicale guidata dall'ironia inconfondibile di Totò, tra gag surreali e fantasia.

programme.title: La donna scimmia
programme.desc: Commedia grottesca di Marco Ferreri con Ugo Tognazzi: Antonio scopre Maria, tutta pelosa, e la porta in tournée come fenomeno da baraccone. Tra scherzi, equivoci e situazioni assurde, il loro strano duo regala risate e sorprese.

programme.title: Accadde al penitenziario
programme.desc: In un penitenziario, le disavventure di un gruppo di detenuti e delle loro relazioni con il personale, tra situazioni comiche e paradossali, creando un mix di risate e riflessioni sulla vita dietro le sbarre.

programme.title: Permanent Midnight
programme.desc: La promettente carriera di uno scrittore comico è completamente deragliata dalle sue folli dipendenze da droghe che lo hanno inseguito da burattini e sparato mentre fa da babysitter alla figlia.

programme.title: Fanboys
programme.desc: Un gruppo di fan di Star Wars raggiunge lo Skywalker Ranch per rubare una copia di "The Phantom Menace," così che il loro amico, un malato terminale, possa vederlo prima che esca al cinema.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Quando Joel (Paul Rudd) e Molly (Amy Poehler) si incontrano, è odio a prima vista: la grande azienda produttrice di dolciumi di lui minaccia di far chiudere la piccola impresa indipendente di lei.

programme.title: Arrivano i dollari
programme.desc: Cinque fratelli scoprono che uno zio morto in Sudafrica ha lasciato loro in eredità una grossa somma. Ma solo liberandosi dei loro difetti potranno entrarne in possesso. Tutti cercano allora di mettersi in buona luce con la bellissima moglie dello zio cercando di ingannarla.

programme.title: Miseria e nobiltà
programme.desc: In pieno Ottocento, Felice e Pasquale, due poveri napoletani, uno scrivano ed un fotografo, devono fingere di essere gli aristocratici parenti del marchese per cui lavorano per riuscire a sbarcare il lunario.

programme.title: Vacanze sulla neve
programme.desc: Durante una settimana bianca si intrecciano le vicende e i flirt di alcuni giovani vacanzieri ospiti dello stesso hotel.

programme.title: Abe
programme.desc: Un ragazzo unisce le culture della sua famiglia nei piatti che impara a preparare insieme ad uno chef di Brooklyn.

programme.title: La casa dei sogni
programme.desc: Una coppia cerca la casa perfetta in cui andare a vivere e decide di assumere un architetto. L'uomo, invece di svolgere il lavoro per il quale era stato assunto, progetta la dimora dei propri sogni.

programme.title: Scambio di identità
programme.desc: Connie, nubile ed incinta, viaggia in direzione di Boston in treno ed incontra una giovane e facoltosa coppia di sposini in luna di miele, Hugh e Patricia. Durante il tragitto, il convoglio subisce un incidente grave e la ragazza finisce in ospedale.

programme.title: Ti presento Bill
programme.desc: Stufo della sua vita, Bill si ritrova mentore di un adolescente indisciplinato ma curiosamente saggio. Quando scopre il tradimento della moglie, Bill non ha più nulla da perdere e si rivolge al ragazzo come modello di ispirazione per cambiare esistenza.

programme.title: Ed ora... raccomanda l'anima a Dio!
programme.desc: Stanley e Steve stanno tornando a Denwer City per consumare le loro vendette. Il primo intende recuperare l'eredità usurpatagli da un parente. Il secondo vuole ritrovare l'oro frutto del suo lavoro di cinque anni, rubatogli da una banda di criminali.

programme.title: Prega il morto e ammazza il vivo
programme.desc: Western ricco d'azione con Klaus Kinski. Dopo che Dan Hogan e la sua banda hanno rapinato una banca, assumono un uomo misterioso per guidarli attraverso il confine messicano in cambio di metà del bottino.

programme.title: Straniero, fatti il segno della croce!
programme.desc: Avvincente film western italiano pieno di colpi di scena. A capo di una decina di fuorilegge, due fratelli tengono in pugno la cittadina di White City. Finalmente, però, un cacciatore di taglie, con l'aiuto di uno zoppo, prova a liberare White City dai suoi feroci oppressori. La missione si rivelerà molto difficile, ma i due proveranno con tutte le forze a liberare la bella cittadina.

programme.title: Giorni di fuoco
programme.desc: Uno spietato petroliere fomenta una guerra tra i nativi e i coloni. Winnetou, capo dei nativi Apache, interviene per la pace, convincendo il capo di un'altra tribù a risparmiare i suoi prigionieri, tra questi il tenente Merrill che si impegna a sposare Ribanna, figlia del capo tribù, della quale anche Winnetou è innamorato.

programme.title: L'Uomo del Sud
programme.desc: La vita della povera famiglia Tucker, che lavorava come spennatori di cotone e decise di ottenere la propria terra, ma la natura è contro di loro.

programme.title: Degueyo
programme.desc: I banditi di Ramon attaccano Danger City cercando un tesoro. Senza trovarlo, catturano o uccidono gli uomini, minacciando donne e bambini con il “Deguello”. Quattro uomini decidono di aiutarli a difendersi e fermare Ramon.

programme.title: Per un dollaro a Tucson si muore
programme.desc: La tranquilla Tucson è minacciata da una banda guidata da Bill Lexter, che vuole rubare un trasporto d'oro. Gli abitanti si organizzano per difendersi e, con l'aiuto di una strategica “lotta tra donne” nel saloon, riescono a distrarre i banditi. La battaglia tra revolver, fucili e pugni termina con la vittoria della città e l'oro al sicuro.

programme.title: Sei bounty killers per una strage
programme.desc: Un western classico ricco di avventura, dove in una città senza legge una banda di criminali impone il proprio dominio. Ma quando la giustizia viene calpestata, qualcuno è sempre pronto a reagire. Tra scontri e coraggio, nasce una sfida per riportare l'ordine e difendere ciò che conta davvero.

programme.title: Bastardo, vamos a matar
programme.desc: Chaco, un messicano braccato da tutti, viene incastrato per l'omicidio di due allevatori. Sebbene tutti sappiano che è innocente, le prove lo condannano. In fuga, si unisce a un cacciatore di taglie per trovare i veri responsabili e dimostrare la sua innocenza.

programme.title: L'ombra di Zorro
programme.desc: I fratelli Billy e Dan vanno in California per uccidere Zorro e vendicare la morte del loro fratello.

programme.title: È tornato Sabata... hai chiuso un'altra volta!
programme.desc: Il feroce pistolero Sabata protegge i deboli e caccia un sindaco corrotto che ha truffato un'intera città.

programme.title: 7 donne per i MacGregor
programme.desc: Derubati dal temuto bandito Maldonado, i fratelli MacGregor avviano una rischiosa caccia per recuperare il loro oro.

programme.title: L'uomo della valle maledetta
programme.desc: Gwen sposa Torito e lo segue. Rapita da una tribù rivale, fugge grazie a un cowboy.
